channel.title: Life in the Simulation
channel.description: Essays, field guides and thought experiments about simulation theory, consciousness, artificial intelligence, attention and living deliberately in a mediated world.

item.title: An AI Benchmark Is Not the Real World

item.description: Choose an external SSD, desktop hard drive or NAS by backup volume, recovery speed, connection risk, maintenance and the need for an offline copy.

item.description: A practical minimalist-phone guide comparing Light Phone III, Punkt MP02 and a locked-down smartphone by compatibility, tools, security and friction.

item.title: Automation Does Not Remove Responsibility
item.description: Why delegating work to software changes the chain of responsibility without making the consequences ownerless.

item.title: Encrypted Cloud Storage Without the Hype: Proton Drive vs Tresorit vs Cryptomator
item.description: A custody-first comparison of Proton Drive, Tresorit and Cryptomator covering encryption, sharing, recovery, workflow and the no-buy option.

item.title: Noise-Canceling Headphones for Focus: ANC vs Isolation vs Earplugs
item.description: A task-first guide to active noise cancellation, passive isolation and earplugs for focus, comfort, awareness and hearing safety.

item.description: A practical RSS-reader comparison covering Feedly, Inoreader, NetNewsWire and the no-buy option by platform, filtering, privacy, export and workflow.

item.title: What AI Chatbots Remember: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini Memory Controls

item.title: Hardware Security Keys Without the Hype: Yubico vs Google Titan—and the No-Buy Option

item.title: A Model Can Be Right for the Wrong Reason

item.title: The Best Books to Understand AI Without the Hype
item.description: A five-book AI reading path covering how the technology works, where it fails, alignment, power, labor and the people living with automated decisions.

item.title: Meaning After Automation

item.title: The Attention Economy Is a Reality Engine
item.description: Competition for attention does more than consume time. It influences which events become vivid, which identities get rehearsed and which futures feel possible.

item.title: When the Internet Is Full of AI Agents

item.title: The Extended Mind Is Already Here

item.title: Is the Universe Made of Information?

item.title: The Real World Is Becoming a Premium Experience
item.description: As synthetic experience becomes cheaper and more abundant, unmediated presence may become one of the scarce goods.

item.title: The Scoreboards We Mistake for Life

item.title: Consciousness Is Still the Weird Part
item.description: Whatever reality is made of, subjective experience remains one of its strangest and most immediate facts.

item.title: AI and the End of Knowing Who Made What

item.title: The Simulation Hypothesis Without the Hype
